desc:
🟢 Welcome to +1 Speed Slime Escape! 🟢

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed
🦠 Run, jump, and escape through a world filled with colorful slime
💪 Train your speed and evolve into bigger and more powerful slimes
🧬 Discover and unlock tons of unique slime evolutions
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Become the BIGGEST and FASTEST slime on the server
🚀 Speed is everything… but one wrong move and you're back at the start 😱

✨ Collect wins, unlock new areas, and evolve your slime into something HUGE!
🟢 Can you become the ultimate slime?
